errors.quote: small relative to the number $N$ of data roles
errors.problem: $N=v^3$ counts the indices $a$ (the roles $X_a$). There are $2N$ data roles $X_a,Y_a$. The page itself later says '$N=\binom h3^3$ counts the roles $X_a$'.

errors.quote: over $\mathbb Q$ $\langle t_S,t_T\rangle=|S\cap T|-1,\ \langle t_T,t_T\rangle=2,$ so each line $\langle t_T\rangle$ is nondegenerate and neighbors span orthogonal lines
errors.problem: The conclusion is stated for both networks but derived only from the rational form, which gives orthogonality only for bit neighbors ($|S\cap T|=1$). For complex neighbors (even intersection) the rational value is $\pm1$. The paper uses the binary dot product there: $t_T\cdot t_T=1$ and $t_S\cdot t_T=|S\cap T|\bmod2=0$.

errors.quote: $X$ labels grow from $A\otimes\langle t\rangle$ to $A\otimes F$, $Y$ labels from $B\otimes\langle t\rangle$ to $(P\otimes\langle t\rangle)^\perp_{A\otimes F}$
errors.problem: The factor $Q=\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_3}\rangle$ is dropped silently. As written, the labels are not subspaces of $\mathcal F$, and 'outgoing labels equal next incoming labels' fails literally ($A\otimes F$ vs $A'\otimes\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\rangle$). The paper tensors every label by $Q$ and writes $Q=\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\rangle\otimes Q'$.

errors.quote: A residual has an orthonormal basis $\mathcal B$ (it has a norm-one coordinate vector)
errors.problem: Residuals carrying a $P$ or $Q$ factor (e.g. center $P\otimes F\otimes Q$, side $P\otimes\langle t_Y\rangle\otimes Q$) contain no coordinate unit vector. The paper's norm-one vector tensors coordinate units with the generators of $P,Q$. The paper also needs the residual nonzero and nondegenerate: a nondegenerate nonalternating binary space has an orthonormal basis.

errors.quote: For nested $U\subset V$, $P_V-P_U$ is the identity on $V\cap U^\perp$ and zero elsewhere
errors.problem: Per the paper, $P_V-P_U$ is zero on the orthogonal complement of $V\cap U^\perp$ (namely $U\perp V^\perp$), not on the set-theoretic rest. This requires $U,V$ nondegenerate and orthogonal projections.

This holds for $V=U\perp E$ (an increasing edge). The paper notes that on a decreasing edge the right side is negated. The page states it for every residual with no sign, although its later $\varepsilon=\pm1$ partly absorbs this.
